as_told.title: EG&G manager tells Knapp of New Mexico saucer and live being

plain: A commentator who goes by the online name UAPGerb told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2026 that a man named Alfred O'Donnell once told a journalist, George Knapp, about a recovered saucer with "live biologics," meaning living beings, kept in the 1950s at a site next to Area 51, a secret military test base in Nevada. In a second telling, UAPGerb adds that O'Donnell said the saucer was moved there in 1954. If true, it would mean the US government held a crashed craft and living occupants for decades.
